_readme: Per-topic visual briefs + golden reference images. The image gate compares candidates against these references (few-shot) and the brief's must_show / must_not_show lists. To tune image selection for a topic, add references and edit the brief; no code change needed. Keys are matched against article title/topic keywords.

vapor-chamber.canonical_form: PLANAR_SHEET: a thin flat copper plate (<1 mm) built from two etched half-shells that are diffusion-bonded; NOT a round heat pipe and NOT a finned heatsink or graphics card cooler.
must_show: flat rectangular or irregular (phone-chassis shaped) copper sheet outline
etched half-shell interior with regular dimple / pillar arrays, or an exploded stack of shell, wick mesh and pillar layers
clean neutral background (studio, white, grey or black render stage)
or an exploded view of a phone / device chassis showing where the chamber sits
must_not_show: round or squashed cylindrical heat pipes
complete GPU/CPU coolers with fans, fins or shrouds as the subject
hobbyist bench clutter, rulers as the main subject, hands, packaging
AI-invented 'cutaway on a blue mat' scenes with props not found in real teardowns
preferred_sources: open-access papers (MDPI, Nature Sci. Rep., IEEE Open)

references.role: exploded CAD render: shell, wick mesh, pillars
real etched copper half-shells with dimple arrays
device-level exploded view with chamber layer

helical-heat-exchangers-beating-boundary.canonical_form: A compact industrial cylinder containing a tightly wound spiral of metal tubing, typically shown as a bare coil assembly or a cutaway revealing the internal helical structure.
must_show: continuous spiral or helical metal tubing wound around a central axis
industrial-grade metallic surfaces like stainless steel, copper, or titanium
clear inlet and outlet ports at the ends of the coil structure
compact, dense winding pattern with uniform spacing between coils
must_not_show: standard straight-tube shell and tube exchangers
flat plate heat exchangers or corrugated stacks
automotive radiator fins or consumer-grade homebrew immersion chillers
abstract 3D renders with glowing neon fluid paths or non-physical lighting
macro shots of generic springs or wire coils without fluid fittings
search_queries: helical coil heat exchanger cutaway industrial
spiral tube heat exchanger internal assembly
compact shell and coil heat exchanger lab photo
helical coil heat exchanger stainless steel fabrication
